Deploys

Service images are built locally by cdk deploy and pushed to ECR from a developer machine, then rolled out to the relevant Fargate service with a rolling update behind the ALB health checks. CI runs lint and tests only - it does not deploy any service. The one CI-driven deploy in the org is the marketing site's S3 sync (website/.github/workflows/s3-deploy*.yml). There is no manual SSH step - a failed health check rolls the task back automatically.

How code gets from a pull request to production. In practice most work lands through long-lived feature branches rather than trunk-based development. Runtime gating is done with Firebase Remote Config (for example the InterstitialsEnabled kill-switch and the A/B group assignment), not by branch strategy; deploys are rolling on ECS Fargate with health-check gating.
